MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 30

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 30

18. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 27

21. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 2

22. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

25. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

26. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 11

27. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

28. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

29. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

30. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
